When used to mean 'at all times', it implies a habitual action or a permanent condition.

faults.quote: Πάντα που τον βλέπω, μου χαμογελάει.
faults.why: 'Πάντα που' is ungrammatical in Greek; 'every time that' is 'κάθε φορά που'.
'At all times' and 'on every occasion' are shades of one meaning ('always').
In standard Modern Greek, 'ντ' word-medially is voiced to [d] or [nd], not [nt].

faults.quote: When used to mean 'at all times', it implies a habitual action
